title: Ready to turn in
caption: All objectives but Turn in ticked: the story card shows the game's ready marker and "Ready to turn in" instead of the count.

title: Story complete
caption: Once the guide's last story quest is turned in, the card shows the journal's completed-quest check.

title: Active quest
caption: Mid-quest on a phone the card keeps the active diamond and the objective count; the diamond now sits centred in its tile, not low.
